readerCopy.body: Escape can look irresistible when the need underneath it has remained unnamed long enough for fantasy to carry all of the pressure. When Neptune squares Lilith, imagination and autonomy create friction, making a crush, fixation, secret plan, or wish to disappear feel larger than the situation can support. The desire is not automatically false because the story around it has become inflated. The moment becomes clearer once the image is stripped back to the ordinary need for attention, freedom, intimacy, rest, privacy, creativity, or change.
